# Public API baseline
#
# Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- code-graphs`, verified by
# `cargo run -p xtask -- code-graphs --check`.
#
# One line per public item, as `<kind> <name>`, sorted and deduplicated.
# Source locations live in `public-api-index.md` instead: this file gates
# the shape of each public surface, not where the code sits.
#
# A diff here is a moved crate boundary. Regenerate to accept it.
